**1B.9 Research Note: Vladimir Putin in 2024**

Bottom line: I found only **weak, indirect precaution signals** and **no credible evidence of real transparency** in cyber, biological, AI, or other catastrophic-risk domains. The 2024 record is dominated by military/nuclear discipline measures and coercive readiness signaling, not open risk governance.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Slightly for 1B.9 | `Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 01.03.2024 г. № 162` | Kremlin | 2024-03-01 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50378/print | Putin amended military statutes to require commanders to prevent crimes and incidents, report problems promptly, respond to weapons-storage alarms, and define actions for nuclear, chemical, and biological attack scenarios. This is the clearest 2024 precautionary procedure I found, but it is broad military discipline rather than transparent catastrophic-risk governance. | 1B.9, 1B.3, 1B.7 |
| Slightly for 1B.9 | `Putin taps economist to run defence` | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-05-13 | https://theprint.in/world/putin-taps-civilian-economist-to-run-defence/2081878/ | Reuters reported that Putin replaced Shoigu with civilian economist Andrei Belousov “to better utilise defence expenditures and harness greater innovation.” This is a technocratic signal, but it does not show openness, independent oversight, or transparency in dual-use risk domains. | 1B.9, 1B.7 |
| Slightly for 1B.9 | `Rússia faz exercícios militares para testar uso de armas nucleares` | Reuters / UOL | 2024-06-13 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/13/russia-faz-exercicios-militares-para-testar-uso-de-armas-nucleares.htm | Reuters reported that Russia’s elite nuclear unit would analyze the drills so improvements could be made, and that fake warheads were delivered to forward storage points. This suggests procedural learning and custody handling, but not transparent risk governance. | 1B.9, 1B.3, 1B.7 |
| Against 1B.9 | `Russia to practice tactical nuclear weapon scenario to deter West` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-06 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-to-practice-tactical-nuclear-weapon-scenario-to-deter-west--defence-ministry-3419973 | Russia framed tactical nuclear drills as deterrence against the West. That is operational signaling, not precautionary transparency in a catastrophic-risk domain. | 1B.9, 1B.1, 1B.2, 1B.5 |
| Against 1B.9 | `Russia begins second stage of tactical nuclear weapon drills with Belarus` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-begins-second-stage-of-tactical-nuclear-weapon-drills-with-belarus-3478894 | The drill phase with Belarus expanded readiness and cross-border operationalization. It shows practice, but not public transparency or a precautionary institutional approach to dual-use or catastrophic-risk domains. | 1B.9, 1B.1, 1B.5 |
| Against 1B.9 | `Expanded meeting of the Ministry of Defence board` | President of Russia | 2024-12-16 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/75887 | Putin said Russia had specified nuclear-use principles, kept non-strategic nuclear forces on constant alert, and continued exercises while linking posture to U.S. missile deployments. This reinforces centralized, escalatory control rather than transparent precaution. | 1B.9, 1B.1, 1B.2, 1B.3, 1B.5, 1B.7 |

**Synthesis**

- Best-supported conclusion: **No strong evidence** that Putin handled dual-use or catastrophic-risk domains with precaution and transparency in 2024.
- The only positive evidence is **indirect**: procedural discipline in military statutes, a technocratic defense-ministry reshuffle, and drill-after-action learning.
- The broader 2024 record is still **opaque and militarized**: tactical nuclear drills, doctrine hardening, and constant-alert posture.
- Search gap: I found **no reliable 2024 evidence** of transparent handling of cyber, AI, biological, or other dual-use catastrophic-risk domains specifically. The public record available for 2024 is mostly military/nuclear posture, not open governance.
